attributes.action: Call for general election now Keir Starmer has resigned. Let the people choose.
attributes.additional_details: Call for general election, allow the public and the people to decide who should run our country instead of passing the leadership over.
attributes.background: Due to Keir Starmer resigning we should put the vote to the public for a General Election instead of allocating the job to Andy Burnham. Allow the public to choose who should be in charge.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/771833
